s1.p: A NEVO Industrial ("NEVO", "nós") é um grupo de engenharia e industrial sediado em Dubai, EAU. Esta política descreve como tratamos os dados pessoais coletados através do nosso site, calculadoras, central de downloads e portais de clientes e parceiros.

items: Dados de contato enviados via formulários, downloads ou solicitações de retorno de ligação.
Parâmetros de projeto inseridos em calculadoras ou configuradores.
Dados de conta dos portais de cliente e parceiro.
Dados técnicos (endereço IP, dispositivo, navegador, páginas visualizadas) via cookies essenciais e analíticos opcionais.

s3.p: Usamos dados pessoais para responder solicitações, emitir cotações, fornecer documentação técnica, operar portais, melhorar a plataforma e cumprir obrigações legais. Não vendemos dados pessoais.

s4.p: Utilizamos cookies essenciais para o funcionamento do site e cookies analíticos opcionais. Você pode aceitar ou recusar os opcionais no banner de consentimento e alterar sua escolha a qualquer momento limpando os dados do site.

s5.p: Compartilhamos dados apenas com prestadores que operam nossa plataforma (hospedagem, analytics, envio de e-mail) e com empresas do grupo NEVO envolvidas no seu projeto. Todos os operadores estão sujeitos a obrigações de confidencialidade.

s6.pBefore: Conforme a legislação aplicável, você pode solicitar acesso, correção, exclusão ou portabilidade dos seus dados e se opor a determinados tratamentos. Para exercer seus direitos, escreva para

s7.pBefore: NEVO Industrial — Dubai, Emirados Árabes Unidos.
s7.pAfter: para qualquer dúvida sobre esta política.

meta.title: About NEVO Industrial — Engineering the Future of Sandwich Panel Manufacturing | Dubai
meta.description: NEVO Industrial is a Dubai-based engineering and industrial solutions company. We integrate engineering, factory development, production technologies, raw materials and sandwich panel supply into one complete industrial partner.

hero.lede: NEVO Industrial is a Dubai-based engineering and industrial solutions company specialising in sandwich panel factories, production technologies, raw materials and complete industrial project development.

story.title: An engineering company built to close the gap between design and industry.
story.p1: NEVO Industrial was founded on a straightforward observation: the sandwich panel industry is served by machinery suppliers, chemistry traders and panel producers — but rarely by engineers who understand all three.
story.p2: Investors were forced to stitch together a factory from disconnected vendors, each optimising their own scope. The result was long commissioning cycles, inconsistent quality and factories that never reached their nameplate capacity.
story.p3: NEVO was created to bridge engineering, industrial supply and project execution under one brand. From feasibility to commissioning — and long after — a single engineering-led partner owns the outcome.
story.p4: Headquartered in Dubai and operating across eight countries, we work with ambitious industrialists building the next generation of production capacity for cold chain, food, pharma, logistics and heavy industry.

mission.title: Seis compromissos que moldam cada projeto.
mission.lede: Não uma declaração de missão — uma arquitetura de missão.

items.b: Every project starts with rigorous engineering — never with a catalogue.
We adopt proven technologies faster and integrate them deeper than legacy suppliers.
A curated network of the world's best machinery, chemistry and steel partners.
Designed for 20-year performance — not lowest bid, not shortest lead time.
We are measured by our clients' plant uptime, quality yield and margin — not by ours.
Energy-efficient production, responsible sourcing and lifecycle thinking in every design.

vision.p1: To become the reference engineering partner for the global sandwich panel industry — combining deep technical expertise, curated technology, and a network of premium suppliers into one integrated offer.
vision.p2: We measure our vision in factories commissioned, engineers trained, and long-term partnerships built — not in units shipped.

whatWeDo.title: Eight disciplines. One integrated engineering partner.
whatWeDo.lede: Every service listed below is owned end-to-end by NEVO — never subcontracted, never resold without engineering.

items.b: Greenfield and brownfield sandwich panel plants — feasibility to commissioning.
Process, layout, utilities, automation and quality engineering.
Continuous double-belt lines, roll formers, flying saws, stackers.
PPGI, GI, Aluzinc, PIR chemistry (polyol/MDI), Rock Wool.
PIR, Rock Wool, roof, wall and cold room systems.
Commissioning, training, spare parts, process optimisation.
PLC, HMI, SCADA, MES integration and Industry 4.0 modules.
Single point of accountability from PO to production ramp-up.

approach.title: Nine engineering steps, one continuous partnership.

items.b: We solve the problem before we quote the equipment.
We specify what fits — not what we're contracted to sell.
The best machinery, chemistry and steel — regardless of geography.
Only vetted suppliers with verified test data and traceability.
Engineers, chemists, process specialists and installation leads.
Support that continues long after commissioning.
Remote diagnostics, on-site interventions, spare-parts logistics.
Positioned between Europe, Asia and Africa for global reach.

presence.lede: NEVO delivers engineering, materials and production technologies across the Middle East, Africa, CIS and beyond — with a curated partner network that follows every project.

values.title: The principles we hire, engineer and partner by.

difference.title: What NEVO is — and what NEVO is not.
difference.isText: An engineering-led industrial partner that integrates engineering, technology, industrial supply and project execution into one complete solution — for the entire lifecycle of a sandwich panel factory.

process.title: From first conversation to long-term optimization.

items.b: Requirements, site, capacity, market — mapped in engineering terms.
Process design, mass balance, utility sizing, layout, DFMEA.
CAPEX model, schedule, procurement plan, risk register.
Vetted machinery, chemistry, steel and auxiliary suppliers.
Manufacturing oversight, FATs, logistics, on-site coordination.
Installation, cold and hot commissioning, performance runs.
Yield, energy, cycle-time and quality improvement programs.
Spare parts, training, remote diagnostics, upgrades.

commitment.title: The promise behind every NEVO partnership.
commitment.lede: A relationship with NEVO is designed for the full lifecycle of your factory — not the duration of a single purchase order.

cta.lede: Bring your factory ambition, cold-chain project, or panel programme to a team that engineers the outcome — not just the equipment.
